title: Run Clippy in Rust CI
why: A Rust project that builds and tests in CI without Clippy misses compiler-integrated diagnostics for common correctness, performance, and maintainability problems.
suggestion: Add a cargo clippy command to a checked-in CI workflow and configure the lint level appropriate for the project.
limitations: Only checked-in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins, and SourceHut manifests are inspected; SourceHut paths are limited to root .build.yml and direct .builds/*.yml or .builds/*.yaml files.

Direct make targets named for Clippy, conventional cargo-run or xtask lint commands, and pre-commit hooks delegated to matching Makefile targets are resolved; reusable workflows, aliases, and other shell wrappers are not.

SourceHut evidence comes only from direct commands in tasks script scalars, not task names, packages, environment values, comments, or descriptions; YAML aliases and shell expansion or multiline command reconstruction are not resolved.
